description:
**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Designer**
 We're seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Product Designer, AI Hub to join our Digital Channels team. This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**
* Make complexity clear \- Take systems that are genuinely hard: multi\-step workflows, cross\-platform journeys, enterprise\-scale data. Design experiences that make sense to the people who depend on them. Understand the problem at depth before touching anything.
* Drive concept development from day one \- Bring ideas from research and outcomes to prototyped form fast. Demonstrate possibilities rather than describing them. Use AI\-assisted tools to close the distance between design intent and working experience.
* Own the design of end\-to\-end experiences \- Map journeys across users, teams, and systems. Identify where things break, where friction accumulates, and what needs to be rebuilt versus refined. Operate across the full scope of a platform experience, not just the screens in front of you.
* Contribute to a design system built for how design works now \- Our design system is structured as machine\-readable infrastructure, not just a component library. Tokens carry semantic meaning. Patterns encode reasoning about when and why they apply. AI agents consume it directly alongside human developers. Contributing here means adding to the grammar, not just the vocabulary, and understanding why that distinction matters.
* Communicate design as a point of view, not a deliverable \- Articulate the rationale behind decisions. Help product managers and engineers understand the tradeoffs. Make design legible to people who don't speak design, without dumbing it down.
* Mentor through example. Raise the standard of work around you through critique, collaboration, and how you approach problems. Not through title.


**The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise**
* Typically, 10 \-14 years of experience, or equivalent demonstrated through portfolio and impact.
* Strong product design fundamentals: research synthesis, interaction design, systems thinking, visual craft
* Experience designing complex systems: enterprise software, multi\-step workflows, data\-heavy interfaces
* Demonstrated comfort working in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where the problem isn't handed to you pre\-formed
* The ability to communicate design rationale to mixed audiences (product, engineering, business) and hold your perspective under pressure


**Preferred**
* You already work with AI\-assisted tools, not just for ideation, but for building and prototyping
* You've worked in shared codebases or repos with cross\-functional teams, or you're actively moving in that direction
* You can describe a moment when AI changed how you approached a design problem, not made it faster, but made it \*different\*
* You've contributed to a design system at the pattern or systems level, not just component execution


**What Will Set You Apart**
* You work at the intersection of design and technical implementation, close to the material, not downstream from it
* You've felt the industry shift happening and leaned toward it
* Your process produces things, not documents


 You have a deep excitement for and understanding of the opportunity that AI creates for design, even if you haven't fully arrived there yet, you're moving fast
   

  

**A portfolio is required, but what we most want to see may not look like a traditional design portfolio.**
 The most compelling thing you can share is evidence of how you actually create products: working alongside product managers and engineers in real time, from research to something shippable, in a way that reflects how modern product teams operate. Show us a process, a repo, a prototype you built directly, a decision you influenced in the room. If you've worked in a shared codebase or repo with cross\-functional partners, bring that to life. If you've used AI tools to get from insight to working experience faster, bring that to life.
   

  

 Beyond that, we want to see what you'd expect: complex systems thinking, end\-to\-end journey work, evidence of design decisions that improved the experience and why. Figma files, PDFs, personal sites, live products: format doesn't matter. Show us the work that best reflects how you think and what you shaped.

Components encode the reasoning behind when and how they apply. AI agents consume it alongside human developers. At the SVP level, you're not just contributing to this grammar, you're shaping how it's defined and ensuring it reflects the quality and intent of the experiences we're building.
* Set a high bar and transfer it. Provide feedback and mentorship that raises the work quality of everyone around you. Cultivate a design culture where rigor, curiosity, and user\-centricity are defaults, not aspirations.
* Communicate design at the executive level. Make the case for design decisions to senior stakeholders. Use visual storytelling to connect design choices to user impact and platform health, not as a presentation exercise, but as a leadership function.

**UX Manager \- ZAIDYN Platform**
**About ZS**
 ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 ZS seeks a User Experience (UX) Design Manager to join our ZAIDYN UX team in our Pune office. The ZAIDYN UX team is a diverse, collaborative and talented group with offices in India and the United States. The UX team within this group owns the user\-centered strategy, research and design in support of the ZAIDYN platform of commercial, clinical, and medical products. The ideal candidate is a strong UX/UI designer with experience leading and working in cross\-functional digital product teams.
   

  

 The UX Manager is a player\-coach leader accountable for the end\-to\-end user experience of a ZAIDYN product area while building and developing a high\-performing design team. The role blends hands\-on design leadership, strategic ownership, and people management in equal measure. We are looking for someone who has 10\+ years experience as a UX Designer with at least 3 years in UX Design leadership/management. A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required.
   

  

 ZAIDYN is a complex, enterprise\-grade, data\-dense B2B platform. You will set the bar for design quality through direct involvement, grow the designers around you, and connect product\-level UX work to platform\-wide standards. Modern UX leadership means designing for interconnected systems spanning users, agents, data, and workflows, applying AI fluently in day\-to\-day design work, and tying design decisions to measurable adoption, retention, and growth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the experience. Drive end\-to\-end UX outcomes for your product area, including usability, adoption, quality, and feasibility, with an explicit success metric and baseline for every initiative.
* Lead hands\-on. Contribute directly to strategy, problem framing, complex workflows, and data\-dense UI, stepping in personally on ambiguous, high\-risk, or agentic design challenges.
* Develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow UX designers and Leads; maintain development plans, run performance cycles, and foster an accountable, high\-performing critique culture.
* Enable delivery. Set team operating rhythms, ensure resourcing and prioritization, remove roadblocks, and improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Influence cross\-functionally. Keep Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success aligned on scope and tradeoffs; turn disagreement into documented decisions and advocate for UX with clear, evidence\-based rationale.
* Align to the platform. Connect your area's work to broader ZAIDYN efforts, collaborate with peer UX Managers on shared standards, and uphold design\-system governance and accessibility as non\-negotiable.
* Contribute to cross\-platform UX initiatives. Including our AI Pattern library and design system, UX metric collection, UX/UI process improvements, and other approaches to grow our team’s impact and delivery of successful product experiences.


**What You'll Bring**
* People leadership. Proven experience managing and developing UX designers, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Enterprise craft. Demonstrated success delivering UX for complex, enterprise\-grade products, operating at both strategic and execution levels on ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Complex domains. Experience in domains such as finance, banking, insurance, or healthcare, including data\-heavy workflows and logic\-based systems (formulas, rules, algorithms).
* AI\-driven design. Active, advanced use of AI design tools in daily work, with the ability to show how AI accelerates workflows and improves quality, speed, or decision\-making, beyond basic concept or prototype generation.
* Agentic experiences. Experience designing interfaces for systems that act on users' behalf, making intent, autonomy, transparency, and control clear, safe, and trustworthy.
* Demonstrated UX/UI skills. Candidate will have a strong portfolio showcasing impactful, best\-practice based UX and UI design.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Measurable improvements in product experience, usability, and adoption (e.g., CSAT, SUS, design\-system adherence, accessibility).
* A strong, engaged UX team with clear growth, accountability, and healthy retention.
* Effective operation as both a strategic leader and a hands\-on contributor.
* Strong alignment across product teams, with design decisions consistently grounded in evidence and tied to business and customer outcomes.

title: Principal UX designer
description:
**About HG**
 HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.
   

  

 Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're seeking a passionate and experienced Principal UX Designer to serve as our Head of UX, owning the user experience design process from concept to delivery. The ideal candidate is a strong advocate for the user, with a track record of creating intuitive, accessible, and engaging digital experiences — and is comfortable operating as a design team of one, balancing hands\-on execution with strategic ownership. You'll be the primary voice for UX across the product organization, translating user needs and business goals into effective design solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Own the end\-to\-end UX design process, from initial research and ideation through wireframing, prototyping, and final implementation.
* Conduct and lead user research and usability testing to deeply understand user behavior, needs, and pain points. Synthesize findings into actionable design insights.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to define product strategy, requirements, and features.
* Create and maintain design deliverables such as user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups using industry\-standard tools.
* Champion user\-centered design principles and best practices across the organization, ensuring design decisions are data\-informed and user\-validated.
* Own and maintain the design system to ensure consistency and scalability across products.
* Manage external design contractors or agencies as needed to supplement capacity.
* Set the design function's standards and processes — critique cadence, research practices, tooling — even as a team of one, so they can scale as the team grows.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years of professional experience in a UX design role, with at least 5 years in a senior or principal capacity.
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates expertise in user research, interaction design, and visual design.
* Proven ability to operate as a design team of one — balancing strategic ownership with hands\-on execution, and managing competing stakeholder priorities without a team to delegate to.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Sketch; familiarity with AI\-assisted design/prototyping tools is a plus.
* Proven experience leading user research methodologies (e.g., interviews, surveys, usability tests) and data analysis.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design rationale to a variety of audiences, including senior leadership.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment is highly desirable.
* A bachelor's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with GTM Intelligence and data platforms is a strong plus.
* Significant overlap with US business hours is required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving, with the judgment to prioritize independently.
* User\-centered design and design thinking methodologies.
* Information architecture and interaction design.
* Empathy for users and the ability to advocate for their needs.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration, especially in the absence of a design team to lean on.


**What We Offer/Benefits**
 We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.
   

  

 We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

What We Do
 
 FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
 



  




 The Role
 
 We're looking for a motion graphics designer who can jump in and start producing from day one—this is a working role, not a shadowing one. You'll be handed real briefs for product explainers, social content, and campaign videos, and expected to take them from concept to final render with the design team's support, not their supervision. You'll also be expected to use AI video and animation tools as part of your everyday workflow to move fast. If you need heavy hand\-holding to get started, this isn't the right fit—but if you're ready to own tasks end\-to\-end and learn on the job by actually doing the job, this is for you.
 



  




 What You'll Own
 
 • AI\-Native Motion: Use tools like Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Veo 2, and AnimateDiff as part of your daily workflow to generate and refine motion assets.
 



 • Multi\-Format Animation: Independently produce motion graphics for social content, product explainers, ads, and internal videos, start to finish.
 



 • Storytelling: Turn product and technical ideas into clear, compelling animated content with minimal briefing.
 



 • 3D \& Editing: Animate and composite 3D renders and video edits for live campaigns.
 



 • Reusable Systems: Use and help build motion templates and design systems the team relies on.
 



  




 Best Suited For
 
 • Working proficiency in After Effects and Premiere Pro (or equivalent)—comfortable enough to execute independently, not just follow tutorials.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with at least one AI video/motion tool, or the ability to pick one up and be productive within days.
 



 • A reel of real work—personal, freelance, or college projects—that shows you can take an idea through to a finished, polished piece on your own.
 



 • Solid grasp of timing, pacing, and visual storytelling fundamentals.
 



 • Comfortable taking a brief and running with it, asking sharp questions instead of waiting to be told each step.
 



 • You've seen every corner of Pinterest and have curated boards for all your visual ideas.
 



  




 What Makes You a Flyter
 
 • AI\-first mindset: You already reach for AI tools to move faster, not just when told to.
 



 • Ready to ship: You can take a task from brief to final output without needing it broken down for you.
 



 • Ownership without oversight: You manage your own tasks and flag blockers early instead of waiting.
 



 • High trust, high candor: You give and receive sharp feedback early.
 



 • Reliable: You follow through on what you commit to, on time.
 



  




 What We Don't Want
 
 • Designers looking for a resume line with no real involvement.
 



 • People who need step\-by\-step hand\-holding to get started on a task.
 



 • Those who avoid AI tools or treat them as optional.
 



 • Anyone who confuses hours worked with value created.
 



  




 Why FlytBase?
 
 • H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out.
 



 • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution.
 



 • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun.
 



 • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage.
 



 • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
 



  




 The Perks
 
 • High agency team and sense of purpose
 



 • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events
 



 • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments
 



 • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster
 



 • Top\-tier health coverage for you
 



 • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out)
 



 • A damn good team to work with
 



  




 Ready to Fly?
